$comment: Golden cases for the default sort comparator. Evaluates against seed.json at seed.now (2026-08-03T10:30:00-05:00, a Monday). The comparator is one function shared by the API, the TUI, and the web UI.

keys: 1. bucket: overdue (0), due today (1), everything else (2)
2. within overdue: due date ascending, so the most overdue sorts first
4. due date ascending, no due date sorts last
6. num ascending, as a total-order tiebreak
comparator.note: Bucket outranks priority. A P4 due today sorts above a P1 due tomorrow. That is deliberate. Do not 'fix' it.

cases.name: home view default order
explain: 108 P2 due 08-07, then 106 P2 with no due date
113 P3 due 08-06, then 103 P3 with no due date
105 is an inbox item and the home filter excludes it

cases.name: bucket outranks due date within a single priority
explain: 102 and 110 are both due today, so they bucket ahead of the rest
102 before 110 on the num tiebreak, since every other key is equal
108 due 08-07 before 106, which has no due date
110 is snoozed, and this filter does not exclude it. Snoozing is a view default, not a sort rule.

stability.requirement: The sort must be total and deterministic. Two runs over the same data return the same order. num is the final tiebreak so that no two rows can compare equal.
